mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 7.5% signals improving labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which initially causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in higher rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity, which is a leading indicator of corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly GDP growth below 1.0% signals economic weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth rate falls below 1.0%
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 quarterly growth falls below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by high housing starts above 950 thousand units), the economy is nearing its peak, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate a slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 950 thousand units.
